description: Compare two open workbooks, a (older) and b (newer): sheets by id, tables by name, rows by key (added, removed), cells by type and value (old and new, by key; number vs text is a type change), columns added, removed, renamed. A key two rows share is reported, never paired. First: changes per column (numbers, dates: up, down, largest); totals; paged.

cells.description: Every cell by address instead: formulas by text, even if values match; names, validations, merges, conditional formats; changes outside the write policy.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page, with the same call.

key.description: Key column. Default the declared or only key column in both.

table_b.description: b's name for the one table given, if it differs.

tables.description: Tables or regions, same name in both (t:Products). Default every table.

name: xlsx_compare
